title: Archive the superseded Gatsby AnthusAI/Anth.us repository
description: Public anth.us is served by Anth.us-Papyrus. The renames (Anth.us-web / Anth.us-legacy-Gatsby) belong to the repository-renames thread; this issue only records that nothing in the Gatsby repo remains to migrate (content already lives in anthus-site-content).
